purpose: Illustrate how evidence objects map to a permitted computational claim without implying intact-formula mechanism.

examples.permitted_claim: ALOX15 is an evidence-gated computational candidate supported by a retained measured compound-target record.
claim_ceiling: does not establish that baicalein is present in the administered preparation
does not establish in-vivo exposure or target engagement
does not establish causal involvement of ALOX15

measured_evidence.temporal_status: no eligible measured record linked to a registered marker compound

examples.permitted_claim: TNF has a literature co-mention signal but is downgraded when the measured-evidence gate is applied.
claim_ceiling: does not establish preparation presence or exposure
does not establish that TNF is irrelevant to the formula
